systemSettings.defaultAgendaGenerationPrompt: Generate a professional meeting agenda based on the following meeting details. Consider the meeting's purpose, participants, and their roles. Create agenda items with appropriate time allocations and assign presenters.
systemSettings.defaultNotesGenerationPrompt: Generate comprehensive meeting notes based on the following meeting agenda and participants. Include key discussion points, decisions, and identify potential action items.
systemSettings.defaultActionItemExtractionPrompt: Extract all action items from the provided meeting notes. For each action item, determine the most appropriate assignee from the participant list and suggest a reasonable due date.
